source_refs.note: Exercise 14.4 Q12, book p.290 (PDF 295). Key PDF 312: sqrt(41) meters, correct (sympy). Solution book PDF 1287 agrees.

blocks.prompt: 12 A drone flies from point \((1, 2, 5)\) to point \((4, 6, 9)\), with each unit representing a meter. What is the magnitude of the displacement the drone experienced during this flight?
blocks.explanation:
Yeh displacement ka sawal hai: drone ek jagah se doosri jagah gaya, aur humein seedhi line ka faasla chahiye.
Diya kya hai? Shuru aur aakhri point, har unit ek meter.
Find kya karna hai? Displacement ki miqdaar (magnitude).
Rule kaunsa? Displacement \(=\) aakhri point minus pehla point; phir us vector ki lambai.
Plan: vector banana, phir \(\sqrt{a^2 + b^2 + c^2}\).
steps:
Diya gaya hai: shuru \(A(1, 2, 5)\), aakhir \(B(4, 6, 9)\), units meter mein.
Humein find karna hai: \(|\overrightarrow{AB}|\).
Tareeqa: Distance formula (14.1.7). Displacement sirf shuru aur aakhri jagah par munhasir hai; drone beech mein kitna bhi ghooma ho, displacement seedhi line hi hai.

Displacement vector
\[\overrightarrow{AB} = (4 - 1)\underline{i} + (6 - 2)\underline{j} + (9 - 5)\underline{k}\]
\[= 3\underline{i} + 4\underline{j} + 4\underline{k}\]
Kyun: "Aakhri minus pehla": har coordinate mein se shuru wala coordinate minus kiya. Yani drone 3 m \(x\) ki taraf, 4 m \(y\) ki taraf aur 4 m upar gaya.

Miqdaar
\[|\overrightarrow{AB}| = \sqrt{3^2 + 4^2 + 4^2}\]
\[= \sqrt{9 + 16 + 16} = \sqrt{41}\]
\[\approx 6.40 \text{ m}\]
Kyun: 3D mein lambai ka formula Pythagoras hi ka phaila hua roop hai: teeno components ke squares jama kar ke square root. 41 prime hai, is liye \(\sqrt{41}\) aur simplify nahi hota.
Dhyan dein: Components ko seedha jama kar dena \((3 + 4 + 4 = 11)\) ghalat hai; pehle square, phir jama, phir root.

Tasdeeq
\[6.40^2 \approx 41 \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: Decimal jawab ka square wapas taqreeban 41 deta hai. Yeh bhi dekhiye ke 6.40 m har akele component (3, 4, 4) se bara hai, jo hona chahiye.
